Theme

Latin word

novus

novus, nova, novum

adjective; the comparative is rare, and the superlative novissimus means “last” · Declension on Wiktionary

new, not old; new, novel, original; new, unheard of, strange

In this lexicon

  • new

    the recommended word · classical · Catull. 1.1: lepidum novum libellum; Traupman 350

  • original

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Rep. 1.13: nova et ā nōbīs inventa ratiō; Cic. Rep. 1.21: nihil novī vōbīs adferam, neque quod ā mē sit cōgitātum aut inventum

  • strange

    also used · classical

  • annus novus: New Year’s Day

    classical

Examples

  • cui dōnō lepidum novum libellum āridā modo pūmice expolītum?

    who shall I give my nice new little book to, just polished with dry pumice?Catull. 1.1–2
